assets.prompt: Create EIGHT pixel-art walking POSES arranged 4 columns x 2 rows. Image1 is exact employee identity. Image2 is required BACK-RIGHT diagonal appearance for top row. Image3 is required FRONT-RIGHT diagonal appearance for bottom row. Image4 is a two-leg pose guide: use ONLY its SECOND ROW poses 4,5,6,7 for each of your two rows. It is critical to draw the OPPOSITE step, not the common reference stance. In this half step the leg rooted on the LEFT side of the pelvis crosses diagonally toward screen-right and BACK (screen-left boot rises behind), while the leg rooted on the RIGHT side of the pelvis crosses diagonally toward screen-left and FORWARD (screen-right thigh leads). Show the two thighs crossing past each other. Near leg must be BEHIND the far leg, with the nearer knee bent backward. This is the opposite-foot contact/down/passing/up segment of a walk cycle. Top four figures have back-right view matching image2; bottom four front-right matching image3. Keep torso facing direction fixed, never mirror character. Match identity, head size, face, hair, outfit, broad flat shadows and pixel outline exactly. Each row progresses through guide poses 4,5,6,7 with clear counter-swinging arms and alternating anatomical legs. Do not put the same boot forward in both half cycles. No idle poses or other figures, EXACTLY EIGHT isolated full body sprites, all same scale and transparent background, generous equal gaps, no labels or drawn guide.
